a.xlink:title: Represents a field (tile) on the game board. Base class for all field types.
Field that acts as a trap and explodes after a timer or when triggered by a unit (Bombed Field).
Field that deals damage to units each turn for a limited duration (Burned Field).
Represents a Fortress field on the board, which provides defense and can be captured or destroyed.
Represents a Hill field on the board, which provides a defense bonus.
Field that heals units each turn (Hospital Field).
Field that generates mana for the owner each turn (Mana Mine Field).
Field that provides a temporary shield to units (Shielded Field).
